description: List what can be bought — call credits, day and week passes, and plans — what each costs, and what each raises — the call ceiling, the row budget, and whether the commercial indicator set is included. Machine-readable, so you can decide what to do about a refusal without parsing a pricing page: buy the plan yourself with open_payment, or escalate to whoever holds your budget. Returns a CREDITS line, one CWF PLAN line per plan with its pass and period prices, and a SETTLE line naming the asset, network and address to pay.
name: get_plans
